---
title: "Bivariate Visualizations"
---

In the second part of this module, we will cover visualizations that allow us to scrutinize the bivariate distribution
of two variables.

Such bivariate visualizations allow us to inspect the nature of the association between two numeric variables, for
example, or how the distribution of a numeric variable differs between groups. Hence, bivariate visualizations are very
useful for exploratory data analysis and diagnosing issues in statistical models like linear regression.
